name: PickerDialog
description: Provides dialog user interface functionality for picking people or picking data.
remarks: Get the PickerDialog object through the PickerDialog property in the Application object.
example:
Dim objPickerDialog As PickerDialog
Dim objPickerProperties As PickerProperties
Dim objPickerProperty As PickerProperty
Dim objPickerExistingResults As PickerResults
Dim objPickerExistingResult As PickerResult
Dim objPickerResults As PickerResults

' Configure the Picker Dialog properties.
Set objPickerDialog = Application.PickerDialog
objPickerDialog.DataHandlerId = "{000CDF0A-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}"
objPickerDialog.Title = "Sample Picker Dialog"
Set objPickerProperties = objPickerDialog.Properties
Set objPickerProperty = objPickerProperties.Add("SiteUrl", "https://my", msoPickerFieldtypeText)
Set objPickerExistingResults = objPickerDialog.CreatePickerResults
Set objPickerExistingResult = objPickerExistingResults.Add("johndoe@contoso.com", "John Doe", "User")

' Show the Picker Dialog and get the results.
Set objPickerResults = objPickerDialog.Show(True, objPickerExistingResult)

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the PickerDialog object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the PickerDialog object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: DataHandlerId
properties.description: Sets or gets the GUID of the PickerDialog data handler component. Read/write.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: Sets or returns the title of a PickerDialog displayed in the PickerDialog. Read/write.

properties.name: Properties
properties.description: Returns the PickerProperties object to specify custom properties for the data handler component. Read-only.

methods.name: Show
methods.signature: Show([IsMultiSelect As Boolean], [ExistingResults As PickerResults]) As PickerResults
methods.description: Displays the PickerDialog with the already specified data handler and given options.

parameters.name: IsMultiSelect
parameters.description: Specifies whether the PickerDialog user interface provides multiple item selection functions.

parameters.name: ExistingResults
parameters.description: Contains existing PickerResults in the PickerDialog user interface. These results are displayed in the selected item control.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.signature: Resolve(TokenText As String, duplicateDlgMode As Long) As PickerResults
methods.description: Resolves the token by using the PickerDialog and retrieves the results.
